title: Add Ziban to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Ziban](https://ziban.pages.dev) to image
- Want to see how a fashion item will fit you before you buy? Ziban uses AI to help you visualize your style, so you can shop with more confidence.

Fixes #14728

gist.headline: Try it on, digitally
gist.blurb: Ziban has landed in the garden. Upload a fashion idea, let AI do the fitting-room part, and shop with a little more confidence.
gist.summary: Added Ziban to the Pollinations app directory, giving people an AI-assisted way to visualize how fashion items could fit their personal style before buying.
gist.impact: Users browsing the app directory can now discover Ziban for virtual fashion visualization and more confident shopping decisions.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Ziban as a cozy virtual fitting room: Polli wears a tiny stylist beret and holds up a pastel outfit beside a glowing retro mirror that shows a tasteful AI-styled outfit preview. Include a clothing rack, pixel flowers and code-vines, and a prominent lime-green interface frame to connect fashion visualization with the Pollinations garden.
